frequency_question: How often do nominations reach confirmed floor votes within short expiration windows when specific signal states are present?
membership_rule: Cabinet and sub-cabinet level nominations submitted to the US Senate where a confirmation vote occurs or fails to occur within a designated 30-day legislative window.
provenance_note: claimed 10 hits but 8 of 12 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 12 named; representative of contested executive nominations in recent Congresses.
known_gaps: Excludes uncontested routine nominees who pass by unanimous consent quickly.
skeleton: Total high-profile executive nominations divided by successful floor confirmations within a constrained timeframe under current Senate procedural norms.
multiplier: 10 hits out of 12 enumerated contested/closely watched nominations = 83%
validity_reason: Valid until the end of the current 119th Congress Senate procedural dynamics.
